Definition: Shemajah, the name of twenty-five Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Shemaiah is the name of twenty-five men, and the verses show the spread: a son of Shechaniah in the royal line, a Levite chief who gave passover offerings under Josiah, and a singer who sang loud at the dedication of the wall. The name means heard by Jehovah.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe heard by Jehovah is the promise. Twenty-five men carry it, singers and priests and princes, and I hold that God hears every one of them.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
